rca of the issue: FIX-1 regression root cause (observed iter 129): cc-add-product-select had an empty-string first option so Playwright [role=option] first click selected empty value → POST never fires an item. P19 fix at CycleCount.jsx removed that first entry from the products array literal and added validator 'Pilih produk dulu'. Verified working. FIX-2: TourMenu previously had no outside-click dismissal and <main> had no bottom padding, causing bottom-right action buttons to sit beneath the floating help bubble. P19 added fixed backdrop (tour-menu-backdrop) with onClick close and set 'pb-24' on <main id='main-content'> in App.js (confirmed getComputedStyle().paddingBottom=104px).
